description: Every stored version of one provision with its dates, newest first. Use it to see when a provision changed, then read a version with getNorm `as_of`. `at_archive_floor` marks a text that was already in force when the archive began. To compare two versions, call `getNorm(compare_to=…)`: the answer's `diff` is the word diff, and each side says what its date is (`date_basis`: `in_force`, `eurlex_consolidation`, `source_stated`, `observed` or `archive_floor`), so a floor date stays visible. DATES: each version carries `date_basis`, `in_force_from` (a date the source states) and `observed_from` (first seen here), each with its `*_basis`; the one we do not hold is null. Example: {"law": "BGB", "ref": "288"}
name: listNormVersions
title: List statute versions
